facts.heading: Wife suggested therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he seek therapy because 'it can't go on like this.'
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove about 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time spent leaving apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour to leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Anxiety triggers fire image
facts.content: When Tomas checks, he gets anxious and sees an image of burning in his head.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Fire image seen daily
facts.content: Tomas sees the image of being in flames every day.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Fire image worst at night/morning
facts.content: The fire image is worst in the evening when going out or going to sleep, and in the morning too.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. And in the morning too.

facts.heading: Fire-related issue started two years ago
facts.content: The issue started two years ago after the neighbor's house caught fire.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience of neighbor's fire
facts.content: Tomas experienced an alarm, smoke in the hallway, and people screaming during the fire.
facts.evidence: there was an alarm, there was smoke in the hallway, and people were screaming.

facts.heading: Witnessed neighbor's house burn
facts.content: Tomas stood outside and watched the neighbor's window burn.
facts.evidence: I stood outside in the yard and watched the window burn.

facts.heading: Belief of causing fire
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas feels he can cause it if he doesn't control something and will be responsible.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be responsible.

facts.heading: Anxiety symptoms during struggle
facts.content: When trying to stop the behavior, Tomas experiences anxiety growing until he feels like he is going crazy.
facts.evidence: Then anxiety grows in me, until I feel like I'm going crazy.

facts.heading: Physical manifestation of anxiety
facts.content: Tomas's heart pounded and his stomach felt bad when anxious.
facts.evidence: My heart pounded in my hand and my stomach felt bad.

facts.heading: Wife knows about the issue
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbara, knows about the issue.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife's perception of issue
facts.content: Barbara initially thought it was a habit, but now she sees it is more.
facts.evidence: At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema 40 minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction at cinema
facts.content: Barbara waited outside for Tomas, and the stove was off after the third check.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to come back and the stove was off after the third.

facts.heading: Feeling like a child
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who can't leave the house after the cinema incident.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Job as an electrician in Malomolec
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec. He does wiring in apartments and houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Fear of making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he might make a mistake while working.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake, that I might fall in a flood or something get damaged.

facts.heading: Follow-up on ongoing jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to jobs on the second day to look.
facts.evidence: But I go back for follow-up on ongoing jobs. Just when I go back the second day, just to look.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss tells him he is the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Work slowing down by an hour
facts.content: In the last few months, Tomas's work has slowed down by an hour per day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day.

facts.heading: Fear of losing job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant in fourth month
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Probora, is pregnant in the fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waited three years for child
facts.content: Tomas and his partner waited three years for the child.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years

facts.heading: Intrusive thoughts about harm
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that might harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it might harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thoughts about cutting bread
facts.content: Tomas has thoughts that might cause bread to go by itself while cutting it.
facts.evidence: the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing and then I'm afraid it will go by itself.

facts.heading: Worst when not told anyone
facts.content: Tomas feels it is worst when he has not told anyone about the thoughts.
facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone.

facts.heading: Leaves room when thought appears
facts.content: When the thought appears, Tomas leaves the room.
facts.evidence: I leave the room.

facts.heading: Checking helps calm thoughts
facts.content: Tomas checks something to make the thought stop, which helps calm him.
facts.evidence: Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Sleeps intermittently at night
facts.content: Tomas sleeps intermittently and gets up twice at night.
facts.evidence: I sleep intermittently. I get up twice at night

facts.heading: Checking is sporadic at night
facts.content: Tomas's checking is sporadic even if nothing is there at night.
facts.evidence: checking is sporadic, even if there is nothing there.

facts.heading: Walks with Barbara twice weekly
facts.content: Tomas walks with Barbara about twice a week.
facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, more or less.

facts.heading: Goal to leave woods in five minutes
facts.content: Tomas's goal is to be able to leave the woods in five minutes.
facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.

facts.heading: Goal for child without thoughts
facts.content: Tomas hopes to look forward to a child without the intrusive thoughts.
facts.evidence: And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person gradually exposes themselves to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced
facts.content: Tomas feared someone would force him to leave the door open.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Tomas stated that checking the door just once is big for him.
facts.evidence: It sounds small, but it is big for me.

facts.heading: Feelings for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas wants to tell Barbora that he loves her and hasn't lost interest.
facts.evidence: That I love her. And that I haven't lost my interest in her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's reaction
facts.content: Tomas is afraid Barbora wouldn't want to be with him.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Expectation of Barbora's hug
facts.content: Tomas believes Barbora would hug him.
facts.evidence: She would hug me. That's how she is.

facts.heading: Refusal to discuss thoughts
facts.content: Tomas stated that he does not want to discuss those thoughts yet.
facts.evidence: Not about those thoughts yet.

facts.heading: Plan to check door once
facts.content: Tomas plans to try checking the door just once when he leaves the apartment.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Plan to write down number
facts.content: Tomas will write down a number from one to ten.
facts.evidence: And I'll write down a number from one to ten.
